The augmented crystal shield is a level 70 Melee off-hand slot item created by using an augmentor on a crystal shield.
The ice-dyed augmented noxious longbow is a level 90 Ranged two-handed weapon, created by using an augmentor on an ice-dyed noxious longbow, or by using ice dye on an augmented noxious longbow.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 2 bane bars and a bane pickaxe, requiring 1,440 progress to complete, granting a total of 1,400 Smithing experience.

Dragon Archer hat.x: The dragon archer hat is a member's only decorative chompy bird hat. To obtain this hat the player must first kill at least 2,250 chompies, then talk to Rantz.

sc: The Dragon Scimitar Bundle is a cosmetic override pack that can be purchased from the Marketplace for 180 RuneCoins for members and 200 RuneCoins for free-to-play players.

r: Partial completion of Ritual of the Mahjarrat after finding the tune banite ore scroll
sc: Dragonbane bolts (unf) were made by smithing dragonbane bars on a Kethsian anvil, requiring level 80 Smithing and partial completion of Ritual of the Mahjarrat, producing 75 unfeathered bolts and giving 700 experience per bar.
Dragonbane bolts are now made by casting Tune Bane on bane bolts.
The dragonbone mage gloves are created by using the Dragonbone upgrade kit on a pair of Infinity gloves.
The ice-dyed drygore longsword is made by dyeing a drygore longsword with ice dye.
An eldritch crossbow limb is a rare drop from The Ambassador in The Shadow Reef.

Elven Mage Robe Bottom.x: Elven Mage Robe Bottom is a legs slot cosmetic override that is part of the Elven Mage set.

Empty pressure flask (a).x: An empty pressure flask (a) is an item used in the Flash Powder Factory. The full pressure flask (a) must be taken with a full pressure flask (b) to a mixer machine, any of the dark red arrows on the map, to make powder and gain points.

sc: It is an item that can spawn during one of the puzzles during Desperate Times.
Faruq's toolonomicon is a book that explains how to use Faruq's Tools for Games and it is sold by Faruq in Al Kharid.
Forinthry Royal Chakram is a main hand ranged weapon cosmetic override unlocked by completing tier 61 of Forinthry Frontier with the premier pass.

Fox Jacket.x: The Fox Jacket is a torso slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Fox outfit.

sc: The fragile hunter urn (full) is an item made by filling a fragile hunter urn while hunting.
They can be bought from Yrsa's clothes shop in western Rellekka after completing The Fremennik Trials.
A frost dragon mask is a cosmetic item available from opening elite reward caskets.
It was made by combining a focus sight, hexcrest and slayer helmet (which had to be uncharged beforehand) by using one on any of the others.
The helm could hold a maximum of 20 ferocious ring charges and 40 ring of slaying charges, made by using the rings on the helmet and requiring 60 Crafting.
Garlic powder is created by using a pestle and mortar on garlic.
The scythe was awarded to the first 25 people who successfully completed the Deathcon II event before others, making it one of the rarest items found in-game.

There were also displeased attendees who felt a physical race to obtain such a rare item was unfair on parents with children, disabled and elderly attendees who usually would have trouble to race for the solution online with the young adults.
This caused the majority of the 25 golden scythes to be awarded amongst members of the same community.
This weapon cannot be made using the Smithing skill.
Ground guam is an item that is made by using a pestle and mortar on clean guam, awarding the player with 1 Cooking experience.
The Incomplete ivory idol (with the head, body and legs) is created by combining an ivory idol body, ivory idol body and ivory idol legs.
An infernal dice (d4) is a reward given by Mephisto for freeing him from a binding spell.
The Inverted Constitution master skillcape token is a unlock token awarded to Fresh Start Accounts that reach virtual level 120 Constitution during the Fresh Start Worlds gamemode.
The token can be traded, once, directly to another player (it is not available on the Grand Exchange).
It, along with the regular Summoning master skillcape, could be unlocked by accounts in the Fresh Start Worlds game mode that reached virtual level 120 Summoning.

The cape can also still be unlocked by any account in the main game by consuming an Inverted Summoning master skillcape token, though the inverted cape can only be equipped if the player also has virtual level 120 Summoning.
They are made by using a chisel on a kebbit spike, creating six kebbit bolts.
Alternately, one may obtain bolts by supplying Leon in Yanille with kebbit spikes, at a price of 20 coins per spike.
A large twitching tome was a reward from a Twitch loot crate, earned for having watched an official RuneScape Twitch stream following the reveal of the Archaeology tutorial.
A large XP lamp (Divination) is a possible reward from helping Meg in your player-owned port.
It is also one of the lamps that can be obtained by buying a random large XP lamp from the Waiko Reward Shop run by Boni on Waiko for 2,700 chimes.

Legacy Torva Gloves.x: Legacy Torva Gloves is a hands slot cosmetic override that is part of the Legacy Torva Armour. It is unlocked by equipping Torva gloves. Your new item(s) can be found in the Customisations Interface.

sc: Lunite Inquisitor Regalia is a cosmetic override outfit that is unlocked through the Solstice Showdown promotion from Treasure Hunter.

The Mask of the Yellow Wyrm is a slayer mask obtained from the Shattered Worlds Reward Shop for 23 million shattered anima.
Before a higher tier can be bought, previous tiers must also be bought.
The memoriam crystal z04 is found on Freneskae.
It is a possible reward from opening a prawn ball at a 11/200 chance and can be traded between players.
Outside of construction, this item was completely useless and dropped by most players, but after an update on 26 November 2018 this item can now be disassembled.
It can be bought from Wizard Elriss in the Runecrafting Guild for 32 Runecrafting guild tokens (requiring 50 Runecrafting), or ten of them from Wizard Rinsit for 2,000 Runespan points.
A miner helm (mithril) is an item that can be made in the Artisans' Workshop.
Observation: Imprinting is a memory found in JasKra's chamber during Heart of Stone.

sc: They are found on the floor in the north-west corner of the pillory area with the cowbells, and should be used on the de-lore-ing device to fine-tune it before operating it once more.
Pigswill is a type of fermented alcoholic beverage made from raw bacon.
It is made by using two soft clay on a potter's wheel, requiring 33 Crafting and giving 28 experience.

sc: It is a reward from Amascut, the Devourer.
Rogue boots are pieces of members-only clothing, obtainable as a rare reward by searching fallen rubble in the Flash Powder Factory.
Shengo seeds can be obtained in Herblore Habitat and are used to grow Grimy shengo, the herb used to make Juju cooking potions or Juju fishing potions.

The seeds can be found by hunting Common jadinkos, Carrion jadinkos, Draconic jadinkos, Saradomin jadinkos, Guthix jadinkos and Zamorak jadinkos, or by exchanging points earned at the Jadinko Lair for seeds.

Silken turban (blue).x: The blue silken turban is part of the silken outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

sc: Silver ore is an ore that can be obtained through mining silver rocks, requiring level 20 Mining, in various places around RuneScape.
It is dropped by snakes and poisonous snakes.
Soulrune gloves are tier 9 necromancy tank gloves available in Daemonheim as part of the soulrune armour set.
They are made from ensouled runic cloth and ensouled thread with level 82 Crafting.
It is dropped by the troll brutes in the caves north of Burthorpe.
The tier-40 starfury cape is also hybrid and has better stats, but it can only be obtained on a members world and is unavailable to Ironman accounts.
A stack of presents is an item unlocked by activating a stack of presents token, which can be obtained through the 2017 Christmas Advent Calendar or from a Christmas piñata loot bag.
During River of Blood, it is made by combining a blisterwood shaft, wolfbane, and the broken Sunspear, requiring level 75 Fletching.
In addition, vyres killed this way have a 20% chance of dropping loot similar to that given by shiny columbarium keys.

Super disco hands.x: Super disco hands were a reward for completing the second column of the list of resolutions five times in the New Year's Resolutions Treasure Hunter promotion, or could be obtained from a purple balloon during the 300 Million Party.

sc: The outfit has also been available in the Yak Coin Shop for 6 Yak coins.
Tatty graahk fur is an item that players may obtain whilst hunting horned graahks, which requires level 41 Hunter.
Torn cloth can be obtained through Treasure Hunter from 9 May 2014 to 12 May 2014 23:59 UTC.
It is created by combining the top, middle, and base pieces.
Each piece can be obtained via different activities on Anachronia.

Tribal trousers (green).x: The green tribal trousers are part of the tribal outfit item set. They give no bonuses and are a cosmetic item.

Vannaka's Sword.x: Vannaka's Sword is an override that is unlocked upon completion of Beneath Cursed Tides. It is a steel 2h sword held with just one hand, a replica of the sword Vannaka uses.

sc: Varrock armour 3 is the reward given to players by Vannaka upon completion of the easy, medium and hard Varrock achievements.
Volatile fire rune fragments are an item obtained during the Succession quest by using inert fire rune fragments on Adrasteia the Forgotten.
It is solely obtained from loot chests awarded for defeating Zemouregal & Vorkath in hard mode.
It is created by using weapon poison potions on a potion flask.

Witch Accessories Mega Bundle.x: The Witch Accessories Mega Bundle is a cosmetic override pack that can be purchased from the Marketplace for 570 RuneCoins for free-to-play players and 513 RuneCoins for members. The Ravenwing Witch Bundle and Graveglow Witch Bundle can also be purchased individually; however, the bundle cannot be purchased if any individual components are already owned.
